description: ARQ D_PDUs from a node this node has no connection with draw WARNINGs with reason 1, one per received type, sent after contention.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). At 2000, from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.2, address size 4, EOW 0, EOT 10 (end 7000): two DATA-ONLY (type 9, FSN 0 and 1, 3-byte segments) and one ACK-ONLY (type 10, RX LWE 0, no ack data). No connection exists, so each draws a WARNING with reason 1, connection-related D_PDU while unconnected (C-0578, C-0579, C-0734); the second DATA-ONLY finds the same WARNING still queued and adds nothing (C-1075). The CAS is told D_WARNING_TRANSMITTED, which has no output. Burst end 3000: data is queued and the prediction 7000 is ahead, so csma.vdcd_end 4000 ms. At 7000 rule 1 applies (the burst was addressed only to this node, K-0067, K-0068): CONT_WAIT at once, seed 0 slot 15, 45000 ms. At 52000 one transmission carries two WARNINGs (type 15, address size 4, source 0.0.1.2, destination 0.0.1.3, EOW 0), RECEIVED FRAME TYPE 9 then 10, reason 1, oldest first (C-1041). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 256 bytes and 4800 ms a block; 16 bytes fit one block, duration 5550, EOT ceil(4950 / 500) = 10. WARNINGs are not acknowledged (C-0386); at transmit_done nothing is queued.
